notes.title: Hackers and Racism are being dealt with
notes.notes:
Apparently, there are hackers in the game now and using profanity and racism to sabotage the game. I am making a hotfix to solve the problem immediately. Will come out with detailed solution as i dont know how that happened and how can someone do this. 

Also, adding a profanity filter from now on so people cannot just use insensitive names. 

Thank you for enduring all this. I am on it right now!

notes.title: Song Updates and UI Upgrade
notes.notes:
Added 12 more songs to play on

Better UI Integration with improved controller support. Cleaned a lot of UI.

Fixed bugs where game won't start when pressed play again.

Cleaned up the leaderboard so that people can see the scores better

notes.title: Version 2 is OUT!
notes.notes:
VERSION 2 is OUT y'all!

This includes 12 more songs to select from.

Added 3 new artists to the pool.

UI updates with much more cohesive controller support.

Major bug fixes and some performance updates.
